title: [3.0-beta5] Suspected missing Open Humans queue
body:
For me the Open Humans page does not have the queue size like 2.8.2.  With 2.8.2 for me sometimes the queue just grew but unticking/ticking the while charging box got it going again.  Without a queue how can I check it is uploading? [3.0-beta5] Samsung A41 Android 11.
![Screenshot_20211114-131318_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43484095/141683950-c3081e1f-a4dc-4ce0-a0bd-b7997890e76f.jpg)



Reporting bugs
--------------
- **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused
  the problem
- Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the
  upper-right corner).
- Obtain the app's log files, which can be found on the phone in
  _/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/info.nightscout.androidaps/_
  See https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/EN/Usage/Accessing-logfiles.html
- Open an issue at https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/new
